note: Hand-authored (docs/TRADE_DESIGN.md §2.3, §5.1, §5.2; step 2 of §9). The deal price (kappa, the hub limits) and the fiscal styles: the regime of a polity (national_banks.json banks[].regime) -> its style. A polity without a bank (a no-state zone) takes 'no_state'. Anchors: ship_economics.json fees (docking 150 + 0.9 Cr/t dry mass, cargo handling 12 Cr/t), EU VAT 17-27 %, Singapore GST 9 %, tithe 10 %. Step 4: the docking fee covers berth_included_hours at the berth, then berth_cr_per_hour (<= berth_cr_per_day_cap per 24 h), both x port_index; 'duty' = the import duty base on goods bought in another polity, x economy_rules.json customs.by_channel[].fee_mult (WTO average tariffs ~5-9 %). Step 7: income_tax = the residence polity's tax on the profit of a 90-day period (OECD average corporate tax ~23 %), declared and due 15 days after it ends (quarterly returns); tax_admin_fee of the tax (bureaucratic); a late (unpaid) tax becomes a debt + a one-off 5 % penalty; withholding_share at source on a contract reward from another polity's issuer, credited at home only through an open / licensed channel (tax treaties).

deal.bulk_note: bulk goods go through a bulk terminal (grab cranes / conveyors / pipes): iron ore port handling is a few $/t vs ~$10/t of general cargo -> 0.3 of the tariff (step-16 balance: 12 Cr/t ate 40 % of the ore proceeds)

construction.note: TRADE_DESIGN §6.2 (step 16, minimal set). The player's construction contract takes over a PLANNED expansion project of a city hub (the hub's own plan: geometry and the s1..s4 stage kits are drawn as they are; the mine hub meshes are never touched). 3 contractor offers per hub and week: price = base_cost_cr x kind factor x (1.15..1.30), work days = base_work_days x (0.9..1.4) (a game-time scale: the hubs' own projects take years), reliability 0.6..0.95. Milestones s1..s4 pay 15 / 30 / 30 / 20 % at 0 / 25 / 50 / 75 % progress, the last 5 % (the retention) at the acceptance; an unpaid milestone halts the work ('funding'), 180 days unpaid -> the contractor leaves (abandoned); random halts p = halt_p_day x (1.5 - r), 1..5 days. The finished module is let to the hub operator: income income_share_year x price a year, maintenance maintenance_share_year (daily, taxable). Not yet: asteroid sites, own production / depletion, staff, supply series paid by the owner, the customer's materials option.

mining.note: TRADE_DESIGN §6.1 (step 16 part 2, minimal set): a concession on a small asteroid at a mining / belt hub. 3 bodies per hub and week (radius 50..2000 m, skewed small; grade 0.5..3; ore_rare 1 in 5). Lease: application + survey at signing, rent per year = 2000 + 6 Cr x radius m x grade (daily), 90 days unpaid -> the lease lapses. The rig is a construction contract (kind 'minehead', base cost 3.05 M = PLAYER_ECONOMY §4 minimum; not drawn - the mine hub meshes are not touched). Once built: a shift of 12 (wage per month each), output t/day = base x (0.5 + grade / 3) x min(1, reserve left / 5 % of the reserve); reserve = the body's volume x 2.4 t/m3 x the recoverable share. The ore goes to the mine's stockpile and is sold daily at the hub's market (the ordinary deal: the price falls with the stock); royalty to the state on the proceeds; or (part 3) the owner keeps it in the stockpile and hauls it from there in his hold (load at the mine's hub) to a better market. Anchors: a standard 3126 mine object (MINES.md) = 120 workers, 6 000 t equipment, ~1.3 Mt/yr in Sol -> a player rig ~1/10 of it in people and ~1/25 in output; royalties 2..10 % of value (real mining law).

bots.note: TRADE_DESIGN §6.4 (step 15, minimal set). A hub's agency offers candidates per week (hidden traits 0..1 from a hash: skill, discipline, punctuality, thrift, honesty, nerve - a beta-like spread with a tail of idiots); the CV shows an estimate of the skill embellished by (1 - honesty). Hired onto an owned ship not flown by the player; the order 'trade loop' (this hub <-> the other market hub of the system with the best margin) runs abstractly once a day with the server's own deals on the owner's money: route error p = 0.02 + 0.25 (1 - skill)^2 -> +1..2 days; a late leg p = 0.5 (1 - punctuality) -> +1 day; theft p = 0.02 (1 - honesty)^2 per trip, 5-30 % of the cargo. The wage 4 000 x (0.6 + 0.8 skill) / 30 days is paid daily; 30 unpaid days -> the bot quits. Reports reach the owner a day later. The bot's ship stays where it was (it materializes near the player only - HUB_SECURITY §3). Not yet: other orders, panic, wilfulness, hijacking, fines to the owner, the Bayesian trait estimate.

rescue.note: TRADE_DESIGN §4.2 (step 12, minimal set - variant A only). SOS calls come from the world, not a random spawn: per hub and day with probability sos_per_hub_day a call appears near that hub whose own service is busy (a capsule 60 %, a ship without power 25 %, a medical evacuation 15 %), open for open_days. A licensee (the 'sar' licence of that hub's polity) takes it in F5 -> МЧС and completes it by reaching that hub (the search near the hub is abstracted until the navigation can target a point in space); the reward is paid by that polity's bank and is taxable. Not yet: variant B (duty for tax credits), towing, salvage rights, inter-stellar search, the obligation to help without a licence.

employment.note: TRADE_DESIGN §11b (author 2026-11-20: the hiring board is in F5 as the state employment service). Each hub posts, per week, two courier vacancies (a transport company flies its ship, the pilot is paid a wage) and one military post of the hub's polity (Галера+; citizens only - the home bank's polity). The courier needs the pilot licence category cargo_courier (granted at the start). Hiring spawns the employer's ship next to the pilot (Player-role, the employer owns it) and moves the pilot into it; the wage is paid daily (wage / 30) by the employer's bank and is taxable income; quitting moves the pilot back to his own ship (it must be within 20 km). Anchors: the pilot wage anchor 4 000 Cr / month (ECONOMY_BANKING); a conscript is paid less.

arrest.note: ECONOMY_BANKING 2026-11-20 (author: «могут тупо арестовать корабль и спустить его с молотка»), TRADE_DESIGN §11d, minimal set. A ship docking at a hub of the polity whose bank holds a debt of the player overdue >= after_days is arrested at once: an exchange seizure (ZPO §811 Austauschpfändung) - the court swaps the most expensive catalog modules for the cheapest compatible working products (largest price gap first) until the proceeds cover that bank's debt; the gap sells at auction_share (judicial sales ~60 %); the proceeds repay the bank, the rest goes to the client. The ship is not detained (no stranding) and stays flyable; a hull with nothing seizable (the legacy Cobra, already-cheapest modules) is left alone - the tool of trade is protected.

insurance.note: TRADE_DESIGN §3.6 (step 13, minimal set). Cargo insurance bought at a berth (F8 ГРУЗ): covers the player's own lots aboard at that moment for days_valid days; premium = cargo_premium_share x value x (1 + 2 x risk) (risk 0 until routes carry one); value = the hub's mid price x tonnes (the good's base price where it is not traded). A loss of the ship (combat, impact, atmosphere, crush) pays (1 - deductible_share) of the insured lots that were lost; contraband (banned here, restricted without the licence) cannot be insured. Hull insurance needs the ship's value and the ship change base - deferred.

licences.note: TRADE_DESIGN §4 (step 11, minimal set). A licence is issued by a polity, valid on its hubs, for days_valid days; bought at a berth of that polity (F5 -> the state app -> licences), the fee x the style's port index, into the polity's bank (refused without the money - not a debt). A good 'restricted' in the hub's regime family needs the licence that lists it; without it the good is contraband (the open market refuses, customs seize, the black market pays shadow x 1.3). Pilot licence categories (author 2026-11-20, like a driving licence in Дія): the start grants 'cargo_courier' (assisted); 'newtonian' opens later. Not in the minimal set: trader (VAT) registration, passengers, mining, salvage, SAR, mercenary, bloc licence, Lotus cordon.

npc_market.note: TRADE_DESIGN §2.4 / §2.6 (step 10, minimal set). Dumping: above dump_from_ratio x target the price target x (1 - dump_depth x clamp((S/T - from)/span) x (1 + dump_shelf_ref_days / shelf_days)), >= dump_floor (fresh food 20 days spoils fast); a glut (> glut_ratio) may fall and a shortage (< shortage_ratio) rise extreme_daily_change a day (panic buying / clearance). NPC speculators between the hubs of ONE system: they see the destination's bulletin npc_lag days old, ship when bid_dest - ask_src - npc_delivery_cr_t beats npc_min_margin of the ask, q = npc_k x dest turnover x excess margin (<= npc_max_share_of_flow x turnover, only the source's stock above half its target), landing after npc_travel days. Inter-system speculators need the jump graph in the economy - deferred.

smuggling.note: TRADE_DESIGN §2.8 (step 9, minimal set). The customs inspection at docking: p = economy_rules customs.by_channel[channel].inspect_p (channel = the player's home bank vs the hub's bank; the same bloc = open) x regime_mult (the hub's regime family strict / its market regime planned x1.5). Found: p_find = hide x attention (in the open: the hold holds nothing legal; hidden in legal cargo 0.7), attention = 1 + 0.25 x seizures by this polity in 365 days (<= 2). Found contraband (banned here, or restricted without a licence - licences are step 11) is seized, fine_mult x its value at the hub (chargeFine: never refused), a contract carrying it fails. An inspection costs inspection_fee_cr (the importer pays, as in US customs). The black market buys contraband at the shadow price (the free cell price, or the base price where the good is not traded) x black_mult[legality]; no VAT, no handling, not declared income; at most black_cap_t a day per hub.

market_regimes.note: TRADE_DESIGN §2.5 (step 8). corridor: the basket's price held in anchor x [price_min, price_max]; below ration_below_stock_share of the target stock a buyer gets max(ration_min_t, ration_stock_share x stock) a day (rationing, not a price). planned: the state price = anchor x [state_price_min, state_price_max] (a hash per polity / good / plan period of plan_days), no deal impact; the hub sells only the stock above state_need_share x target ('нет в продаже' otherwise - Kornai's shortage economy). mobilization: planned for its groups only. The shadow price (the free cell price) keeps moving underneath - the black market of step 9 trades at it.
